name: moneybird-mcp
description: Read your Moneybird bookkeeping with Claude; optional experimental writes require an explicit local capability setting and supervised previews.
long_description: Connects Claude locally to your Moneybird administration. Read invoices, purchase documents, contacts, bank mutations and financial reports. The extension defaults to read-only. Setting capability mode to write_enabled exposes experimental prepare-and-execute bookkeeping tools; review every preview and verify the action-specific result. An approval ID binds a prepared payload but is not independent proof of human confirmation. Includes Dutch bookkeeping prompts such as 'koppel_banktransacties' and 'verwerk_achterstand'.

access_token.title: Moneybird API token
access_token.description: Create one at https://moneybird.com/user/applications/new — choose 'Persoonlijk gebruik' (personal use) and copy the token shown.

administration_id.title: Administration ID
administration_id.description: Optional. The long number in your Moneybird URL (moneybird.com/<this number>/...). Leave empty if your token has exactly one administration.

data_dir.title: Data folder
data_dir.description: Where the search index, approvals and audit log are stored on your computer.

capability_mode.title: Capability mode
capability_mode.description: Safe default: read_only. Enter write_enabled only to expose experimental supervised write tools. Review each preview; this switch and an approval ID do not independently prove human confirmation.
